title: extract_account_id duplicated verbatim in every handler module
description: email.rs, mailbox.rs, thread.rs, identity.rs, snippet.rs, vacation.rs, submission.rs each contain a private fn extract_account_id with identical body. A contributor adding a new handler module will copy it again. Any change (e.g. better error message, tracing) must be made 7+ times or a divergence bug is introduced. Move to a crate-level private helper.
